netlifyRouting: netlify.toml:12-15 rewrites /api/* -> /.netlify/functions/:splat (status 200); no config.path export in image.ts

methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. Any method (POST, PUT, DELETE, ...) is handled exactly like GET; the body is never read.

auth.notes: Auth runs first, before query validation. Bearer header regex /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i (_shared/http.ts:20-25). DEV_SECRET_KEY bypass when token === env DEV_SECRET_KEY (_shared/auth.ts:14-20). Otherwise Supabase adminClient().auth.getUser(token) (_shared/auth.ts:22-24).

query.name: deckId
query.parse: searchParams.get('deckId'); empty string treated as missing
query.bounds: no format check; a non-UUID string reaches ownsDeck -> Postgres uuid cast error -> 500

query.name: slide
query.parse: Number(p.get('slide')); must satisfy Number.isInteger && > 0. Number(null)=0 and Number('')=0 are rejected; '1.0' and ' 2' are accepted (Number coercion)

query.name: v
query.bounds: none; v>=2 selects refine key slide_N_vV.png
query.invalidBehaviour: never an error; invalid values silently fall back to the original image

query.name: <any other, e.g. variant>
query.parse: ignored (frontend tests and old URLs pass variant=A)

checkOrder: 2. deckId present and slide positive integer (400 'Bad params')
3. ownsDeck(userId, deckId) (403 'Not your deck'; DB error incl. non-UUID deckId -> 500)
4. v -> key: refined (v>=2) 'deck/{deckId}/slide_{n}_v{v}.png' else 'deck/{deckId}/slide_{n}.png'; fallback legacy 'deck/{deckId}/slide_{n}_variant_A[_v{v}].png'
5. no bytes in either key -> 404 'Image not found'

responses.when: image blob exists under the new or legacy key
responses.bodyShape: raw PNG bytes. For non-tile slides: the stored blob verbatim (whatever size gpt-image produced). For workzone tile slides with a resolvable brand master: a 2560x1440 PNG = brand 'master' PNG resized (fit:fill) to 2560x1440, with the tile resized (fit:fill) to the workzone rect (round(left*2560), round(top*1440), round(width*2560) x round(height*1440)) and its white background knocked out, composited on top.

errors.when: Supabase getUser fails or returns no user
token equals DEV_SECRET_KEY but DEV_USER_ID unset
deckId missing/empty, or slide not a positive integer
deck does not exist or is owned by someone else (indistinguishable)
no blob at the versioned key nor the legacy key (incl. slide still generating, version never rendered, slide number out of range)
any non-HttpError: Supabase error (e.g. non-UUID deckId -> Postgres 22P02), blob store failure, missing SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

sideEffects: none (read only). Blob store 'deck-images' read; job store 'deck-jobs' read for tile compositing; brand-assets store read for master PNG.
externalCalls: Supabase (auth.getUser, decks select, brands/profiles via resolveBrandSource)
sharp (local image processing). No paid API.
quirks: No method check: POST/DELETE/etc. return the image like GET (image.ts:65-94).

Compositing is best-effort: any error (job state missing, brand unreadable, kit has no workzone or degenerate workzone, kit.masterKey falsy, src.brandId unset, master blob missing, sharp failure) returns the raw tile bytes with status 200 and the same headers (image.ts:24-62).

Compositing only triggers when job state slides[slide].isTile is true AND job state has brandId (image.ts:28-29). Always uses the 'master' (content/Layout) asset kind, keyed by the brand owner's id (src.assetOwnerId), never titleMaster/dividerMaster (image.ts:35-37).
Compositing requires kit.masterKey truthy but re-derives the blob key from owner+brandId; the kit's stored key string is not used (image.ts:35-36).
A composited response is always 2560x1440; a non-composited response has the stored PNG's native size.
Legacy key fallback: pre-variant-removal decks stored slide_N_variant_A.png / slide_N_variant_A_v{v}.png (image.ts:77-80; _shared/blobs.ts:19-25).
v=1 or omitted or invalid always reads the original key even if the slide's current version is >1; the caller must pass the current version (from /api/status imageUrl) to see refined renders.
Ownership 403 is checked before blob lookup, so an unknown deck yields 403 not 404.
Non-UUID deckId yields 500 'Internal error' (no UUID guard in ownsDeck), unlike brand routes which guard UUIDs (_shared/db.ts:189,228).
image.ts returns result.buffer (the underlying ArrayBuffer of the sharp Buffer) for composites (image.ts:58); for large PNGs this is a dedicated ArrayBuffer so bytes are correct.
Blob reads are eventually consistent; the frontend retries 404s (SlideImage.tsx/VariantCell.tsx comments) so a reimplementation must keep 404 (not 5xx) for not-yet-visible images.
beforeAnyState: Deck row exists but no image yet (generating) -> 404 'Image not found'. Deck row absent -> 403 'Not your deck'. Job state absent -> raw bytes (no compositing).

tests.asserts: 200 + content-type image/png for owned deck; 404 when blob missing; 403 for non-owner. callers.where: src/components/SlideImage.tsx:10,68 (URL /api/image?deckId=&slide=&v=); src/components/VariantCell.tsx:14; src/lib/useAuthedImage (fetch with bearer, retries 404)
callers.expects: 200 PNG body; non-2xx treated as retryable then 'reload' affordance

Proxies GET with params deckId, slide, and v only when provided; any status >= 400 -> its own 502 'Image failed (<status>)'; on success re-serves resp.content with upstream content-type (default image/png) and its own cache-control 'private, max-age=3600'. Relies on content-type passthrough and 2xx/>=400 split only.

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:754-788 - matches (GET, deckId uuid required, slide integer>=1 required, v integer>=1 optional, 200 image/png with cache-control). Discrepancies: declares deckId format uuid but handler does not validate (non-UUID -> 500); documents no error responses (400/403/404/401/500 missing); does not mention that v=1/invalid silently serves the original.
